part1_forecasts.statement: The US will maintain over 65% of global AI compute by August 2027, with China's share remaining below 20%.

resolution_criteria.source: Center for Security and Emerging Technology (CSET)
resolution_criteria.metric: global AI compute share (United States vs. China)

part1_forecasts.statement: The US will generate at least $50 billion in cumulative tariff revenue from advanced AI chips not designated for domestic supply chains by the end of 2027.

resolution_criteria.metric: cumulative tariff revenue from advanced AI chips
resolution_criteria.counting_convention: USD, collected revenue from imports subject to the 25% tariff, measured annually

part1_forecasts.statement: China's Ministry of Commerce will announce at least one new set of restrictions on specific rare earth element applications by mid-2028.

resolution_criteria.metric: number of new rare earth export control announcements targeting specific applications
resolution_criteria.counting_convention: announcements, in-force regulations impacting specific end-uses

part1_forecasts.statement: The annual count of state-led industrial policy interventions globally will increase by at least 15% from 2025 levels by the end of 2027.

resolution_criteria.source: Global Trade Alert (New Industrial Policy Observatory - NIPO)
resolution_criteria.metric: annual count of state-led industrial policy interventions
resolution_criteria.counting_convention: count, new interventions registered annually, encompassing all types

part1_forecasts.statement: European Union automotive manufacturers will experience a cost increase of at least 10% for critical micro-transistor components by the end of 2028 due to concurrent trade policies.

resolution_criteria.source: European Commission Directorate-General for Internal Market, Industry, Entrepreneurship and SMEs
resolution_criteria.metric: average year-over-year cost increase for critical micro-transistor components for EU automotive manufacturers

baseline.value: 12% (estimated impact of E11 and related supply chain shifts as of Aug 2026)

resolution_criteria.counting_convention: percentage increase, measured annually from baseline cost

part1_forecasts.statement: The US Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) will issue at least one new regulation further restricting the export of advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment to China by early 2029.

resolution_criteria.source: U.S. Department of Commerce Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS)
resolution_criteria.metric: number of new export control rules targeting China's semiconductor manufacturing equipment

baseline.value: Ongoing regulatory shifts noted (E01 refers to a specific rule from Jan 2026)

part1_forecasts.statement: Global nominal GDP growth will average 4.5% annually between mid-2026 and mid-2029, driven by modern mercantilism and AI infrastructure investment but constrained by resources.

resolution_criteria.metric: average annual global nominal GDP growth

baseline.value: Higher-than-target nominal GDP growth observed mid-2026

resolution_criteria.counting_convention: percentage points, measured as a compounded annual growth rate over the specified period

part1_forecasts.statement: At least three new national AI offices, mirroring Malaysia's NAIO structure, will be established in emerging economies by the end of 2029.

resolution_criteria.metric: number of new national AI offices established in emerging economies with national AI action plans
resolution_criteria.counting_convention: count, officially launched offices with a defined mandate and action plan

part1_forecasts.statement: The US 'case-by-case review' policy for advanced AI chips to China will remain in effect for at least three full years from its January 13, 2026 inception.

resolution_criteria.source: U.S. Department of Commerce Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS)
resolution_criteria.metric: duration of 'case-by-case review' policy for advanced AI chips to China
resolution_criteria.counting_convention: years, period of active enforcement of the specific license review standard

part1_forecasts.statement: China will not domestically produce a competitive alternative to the NVIDIA H200 chip by August 2031, indicated by fewer than 50 new foundational patent filings for comparable architecture.

resolution_criteria.metric: number of new foundational patent filings for AI accelerator chips comparable to NVIDIA H200
resolution_criteria.counting_convention: patent filings, per annum, for technologies exhibiting equivalent compute and memory bandwidth
